description: This Java class defines a command handler for updating self-beneficiaries with TPT (Third Party) in a financial application. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface, processes commands, and delegates the update operation to the SelfBeneficiariesTPTWritePlatformService.

classes.name: UpdateSelfBeneficiariesTPTCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles update commands for self-beneficiaries TPT, delegating to the corresponding service.

methods.name: UpdateSelfBeneficiariesTPTCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the handler with a reference to the write platform service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the incoming JSON command and delegates the update operation to the write platform service.
